Slop Drive · Beta

File storage (Drive)

Every file from every app, in one local drive.

Open now

Slop Drive has these main features: Folders, stars, Trash & search; Grid, list, columns, node graph & disk usage. It opens Any file.

Beta: still being tested, so some parts may change.

What you can do with Slop Drive

  • Find duplicate files and similar photos
  • A private Google Drive alternative on your own device
